body:
someone@somewhere.com (Anon) wrote:
>
> In article <19960912.033656.614262.NETNEWS@WVNVM.WVNET.EDU>, jkoepke@wvu.edu
> says...
>
> >Most everyone that posts stuff here are leftists who don't believe
> >in the Manifesto.  If you don't AGREE then please don't post stuff.
> >I really hope that those people do stop so that we can start to
> >discuss the serious issue of the Industrial system.
>
> I think that the most entertaining part of this newsgroup is reading posts by
> pathetic losers like this who freak out whenever someone dares to disagree
> with them.  I realize that you probably have trouble finding anyone who
> agrees with you in real life and turn to this newsgroup to find some
> affirmation of your viewpoints.  Too bad.  Life is tough.
>
> If you don't want anyone to ever disagree with you you are going to have to
> do like Teddy boy and hide out in the woods.  There are those of us who
> recognize Teddy boy for what he really is - a pathetic, cowardly psycho who
> couldn't make it in real life and therefore resorted to anonimously murdering
> innocent human beings to punish them for making it in life.  We have as much
> right to post our opinions here as you do.
>
> I've noticed that the Teddy boy supporters are the only ones who ever try to
> censor this group.  I would never tell anyone that they don't have a right to
> express their opinion, no matter how stupid that opinion might be.  But then,
> I'm not afraid of people expressing opinions that I disagree with.  I like to
> argue with people who have strong opinions.  That is how opinions are tested
> in the market place of ideas.
>
> By the way, I've been called many things in my life, but never a "leftist."
>


Most of the people that have been posting messages have been ones who
don't really discuss the issues.  I HOPE people that don't agree
post so that the pro-MANIFESTO people can make the non-believers
see the light.


Jason

"Our society tends to regard as a "sickness" any mode of thought or
behavior that is inconvenient for the system..."

headers.Subject: Re: the people that post stuff here
